tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// kun bzang bla ma'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs bdud rtsi 'byung ba'i zla ba zhes bya ba bzhugs// rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab chen po rje btsun kun dga' bzang po'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir gang zag dad pa dang ldan zhing rang gzhan thams cad legs pa'i lam du 'god par 'dod pa dag gis/ rgyal bas lung bstan pa'i rgyal tshab chen po rje btsun kun dga' bzang po'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor thun mong gi 'gro ba'i snang tshul dang mthun par nyams su len pa'i tshul ni/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ dang po sngon 'gro ni gnas dben par bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan pas/ ngag tu/ mkhyen brtse dang nus ldan// rdzogs pa yi sangs rgyas// lung rtogs kyi dam chos// dge 'dun dang bcas pa// kun 'dus kyi bdag nyid// dga' bde yi dpal ster// mkhas btsun dang bzang po yi// rtse mo la skyabs 'gro /zhes pa lan gsum gyis skyabs 'gro dang*/ de nas/ gzhan don du dam pa'i// byin rlabs dag gzhug phyir// thun mong du snang ba'i// sprul sku yi gzha' ris// ka phreng dang a phreng*// pir rtse dag bsgyur nas// dad gsum gyi rin chen// rtsig ngos su 'dri'o// zhes lan gsum gyis sems bskyed nas/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la yul gsal gdab pa/ bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa/ zung 'jug tu mnyam par gzhag pa ste gsum las/ dang po ni/ ka ba la ma brten// mos gus kyi khang par// kha lnga pas bteg pa'i// rin chen gyi bzhugs khri// ga la ba de na// pad zla yi gdan la// nga cag gi 'dren mchog /e waṃ pa bzhugs so// ca co yis ma phrogs// ting 'dzin gyi sku ni// cha lugs su paṇa zhwa// zlum po yi cod paṇa// ja hong gi mdangs ldan// chos gos ni gsum mdzes// nya gang gi zla ba'i// zhal 'dzum ni me re// ta thā ga ta dang*// rjes mthun gyi dam chos// tha dad kyi skad du// 'chad pa yi phyag rgya// da lta yang gnas gsum// 'bru gsum gyi rdo rjes// na rga sogs med pa'i// go 'phang la bzhugs so// pa tra ltar 'khyug pa'i// 'od zer stong 'phro ba'i// pha gcig gi bla ma// rtse gcig tu bsams nas// ba mo ltar 'dod 'jor// rung ba yi yid sprul// ma tshang bar med pa'i// mchod sprin gyis mchod do// zhes pas gsal btab bo// gnyis pa ni skabs 'dir mdo rgyud kun gyi rgya mtsho sogs sh+lau ka gcig po de tshar gang mang du brjod pas bstod pa'i mthar/

tsakra yis mtshan pa'i// zhabs bsnyen pa bdag la// tsha grang sogs ngan 'gro'i// skye sgo rnams bcad de// dza ya kun 'dus pa'i// gsang gsum gyi byin rlabs// wa yur gyi nang gi /chu rgyun ltar stsol cig /zhwa gos tsam ma zad// thams cad nas khyod 'drar// za chog pa bdag kyang*// de 'dra nyid byin rlobs// 'a cag gi sems dang*// dbyer med du sim nas// ya mtshan gyi ltad mo// bltar med de mthong mdzod// ces gsol ba gdab bo// gsum pa ni de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i rkyen gyis/ bla ma de thugs dgyes bzhin pas 'od zer 'ja' tshon lta bu'i rnam par zhu ste rang gi spyi bo nas thim pas/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ rang gi lus ngag yid yon tan bya byed dang bcas pa dbyer med ro gcig tu gyur par bsams la/ sems khong lhod glod nas dus gsum gyi rtog pa'i rgyu 'grul thams cad bcad de/ sems kyi gshis ci yang ma yin pa/ gdangs gang du yang ma 'gags pa/ rtsal mos gus su dung nge bar bsgom bya sgom byed dang bral ba'i gsal stong 'dzin med kyi ngang du sing nge bzhag sems 'phro na slar yang chu las chu bur rdol ba bzhin du rang gi snying gar pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la sngar bzhin du gsal bar bzhugs par bsams la mos gus rtse gcig pas/ nyi ma ra bi ltar lham mer// snying gi dkyil bzhugs nas// la klung sogs gar phyin// de de yi 'gro ba// sha za dang srin po'i// sems 'dra yang zhi zhing*// sa bon du dge ba'i// rtsa ba'i nyid thebs mdzod// ha nu man+tha yi// rnam dpyod kyang rdugs pa'i// a don nyid legs rtogs// shes rab kyi gzhu bdungs// thabs mkhas kyi mda' ni// drang po dag bskyod nas// sgrib gnyis kyi dgra las// rgyal ba nyid byin rlobs// zhes pas gsol ba gdab bo// gsum pa rjes ni/ zhes pa'am de skad/

i ti dag gang gis// bsgrub pa yi dge ba/ /rgya mtsho/ u da dhi 'phel ba'i// rtsa lag ltar dkar bas// e waṃ pa'i ye shes// gzigs pa yi byin rlabs// sman nam bdud rtsi/ o ṣa dhi'i rgyun 'dra// bdag blo la 'jug gyur// zhes pa'i bsngo ba dang gzhan yang bsngo ba smon lam gang shes brjod do// de ltar gangs can gyi brda dang mthun pa'i ka phreng dang a phreng gi sgras drangs pa'i kun bzang bla ma'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs bdud rtsi 'byung ba'i zla ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rje de nyid kyi sku bstod mdo rgyud ma rgyun du kha ton bgyid pa'i yan lag tu 'di ltar don du gnyer ba'i dge slong bsod nams legs grub kyi ched du/ dpal e waṃ pa chen po'i rjes su slob pa'i 'dun pa ma bor tsam gyi snyan dngags mkhan tshul khrims rin chen gyis sngon byon 'phags bod kyi bla ma bka' drin che ba mang po dag la thun mong gi snang tshul dang mthun pa'i rnal 'byor zur pa sa dge la sogs pa'i mkhas pa mang pos mdzad pa shes byed du byas nas/ de dag gi bzhed pa dang mi 'gal ba'i tshul gyis rnga chen du grags pa'i gsar tshes kyi lo'i zla tshes dge bar rang gi bsam gtan gyi khang bur bris pa phan bde rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig/ // ༄༅// nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi ngag 'don rin chen mgul rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// bla ma mchog dang dbyer med pa'i// mkha' spyod dbang mo la btud de// ches zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi// ngag 'don rin chen mgul rgyan 'dri// de'ang tshogs bsags kyi yul thun mong ba dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can du bskyed pa ni sgrub thabs nyid du gsal la/ 'dir thun mong ma yin pa khrid yig nas bstan pa ltar nyams su blang ba'i tshul gyi ngag 'don ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa sangs rgyas rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can/

sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas rdo rje g.yon dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod dang ldan pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i cod paṇa can/ dar gyi na bza' dang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba/ bdag la dges bzhin du bzhugs pa/ de'i mdun nas brtsams te g.yon skor du/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang nas bzung ste drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma yan gyi brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can du bzhugs pa/ de dag gi mtha' skor du yang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba dang bcas par gyur/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥthugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad tshur 'dus/ bla ma thams cad la cha tshang bar thim pas thams cad skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gyur ces pa'am yang na de nyid tshigs bcad du bsdebs na/ mdun gyi mkha' dbyings seng ges bteg pa'i khrir// pad+ma zla steng sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos// rtsa ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas rdo rje chos// sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis// rdo rje dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas bsnams// zhabs gnyis mi phyed rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs// gzhon du bcu drug lor gnas na tshod can// mthon mthing ral pa'i cod paṇa spyi bor mtshan// dar gyi na bza' rin chen rus pas brgyan// 'od dang 'od zer dkrigs pa'i sku can zhig /bdag la dgyes pa'i nyams kyis bzhugs par gyur// de mthar brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad kyang*// dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam pas bzhugs// gzhan yang yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dang*// nyan thos rang rgyal chos skyong srung ma dang*// nor lha'i tshogs kyis bskor te bzhugs par gyur// kun gyi gnas gsum oṃ dang āḥhūm̐ mtshan// thugs ka'i sa bon 'od zer phyogs bcur song*// rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam rgyal ba sras// chos skyong nor lha thams cad spyan drangs thim// skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid gyur// ces gsal btab nas/

gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid sogs/ rdo rje 'chang chen rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sogs sam/ yang na/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i sogs kyis gsol 'debs gang shes bya/ bshams pa'i mchod pa yod na byin gyis brlab/ med na mi dgos/ oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi sā twa sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha sogs nas spar+ṣe kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis mchod de/ gang la chags na nyes kun 'byung ba'i gzhi sogs nas/ rmongs dang phrag dog zhi bar byin gyis rlobs zhes pa'i bar lam zab ltar dang*/ rang sems baṃ yig rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// dbu ma'i lam brgyud tshangs bug nas 'thon te// rtsa ba'i bla mar zhal sbyor bzhugs pa yis// phan tshun bde ba chen pos mnyes par gyur// rang sems ngo bo rdo rje rnal 'byor mas// rang gi tha mal phung po la gzigs pas// che zhing snum la tsho bar 'dug pa de// sngar nas 'di 'dra'i lus kun don med song*// da lan don can bya'o snyam dgongs nas// phung po'i rtsar byon gri gug rnon po yis// tha mal lus su snang ba'i mgo bo yi// ya thod bcad nas mdun du bkan te bzhag /gang de ches dkar yangs pa'i snod gyur pa// rkang g.yon g.yas dang khog smad nang khrol dang*// khog stod lag gnyis mgo bo'i lhag ma bcas/ de nang bskyur bas sha khrag rgya mtshor gyur// oṃ las chos dbyings sogs nas/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ thar pa'i lam ston zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ brgyud pa'i bla ma'i= yi dam lha tshogs= sangs rgyas byang sems= nyan thos rang rgyal= chos srung nor lha'i= ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po 'di// bzhes nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol// mchod pa'i lha rnams rtsa ba'i bla ma yi// thugs kar thim pas thugs rgyud zag med kyi// bde ba chen pos yongs su mnyes gyur te// mchog tu dgos pa'i nyams dang ldan par gyur// bdud rtsi'i lhag ma rigs drug sems can rnams// lha ru gsal ba'i zhal du=

/chags sdang rmongs gsum rnam rtog zhi ba dang*// byang chub sems 'byangs sangs rgyas thob par shog /skabs 'dir maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma ci nus dang skabs skabs su so bdun ma yang 'bul/ mthar shes shing nus na gang gi mchod rdzas sogs dang*/ deng nas byang chub sogs kyang brjod/ de nas/ rje btsun mchog gi mtha' skor bzhugs pa yi sogs nas/ dbyings kyi rol pas bla ma'i thugs kar thim// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun 'dus bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag la dbang bskur stsol// bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od dkar po// oṃ gyi gzugs byung rang gi dpral bar thim// bum pa'i dbang thob lus kyi dri ma dag /sku yis byin brlabs sprul sku'i sa bon bzhag /bla ma'i mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od dmar po// āḥyi gzugs byung rang gi mgrin par thim// gsang ba'i dbang thob ngag gi dri ma dag /gsung gis byin brlabs longs sku'i sa bon bzhag /bla ma'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od sngon po// hūm̐ gi gzugs byung rang gi snying gar thim// gsum pa'i dbang thob sems kyi dri ma dag /thugs kyis byin brlabs chos sku'i sa bon bzhag /bla ma'i yi ge gsum las 'od sna tshogs// 'bru gsum gzugs byung rang gi gnas gsum thim// bzhi pa'i dbang thob sgrib pa'i bag chags dag /kun gyis byin brlabs ngo bo nyid skur gyur// bla ma mchog la phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// khyed kyis bdag rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas bla ma de 'od zer dmar po bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur nas rang la thim par bsam mo// rang gi snying gar e yig nyis brtsegs sogs dkyus la 'jug go /zhes nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi ngag 'don rin chen mgul rgyan zhes bya ba 'di ni bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal sogs don gnyer gyis bskul ngor/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa bud+dha lak+ṣ+mīs mdzad pa'i ku sa li'i tshogs bsags tshigs bcad ma gzhir bzhag

nyams su blang bde bar ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis lhun grub steng du bris pa dge'o// // ༄༅// nā ro mkha' spyod skabs kyi tshogs bsags bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi ngag 'don nor bu'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// gang la brten nas mthong chos sa bon nas// sku bzhi'i snye ma g.yur du za ba'i bar// ci 'dod lag rtser sbyin mchog rdo rje yi// slob dpon rtag tu bsnyen pa'i rnal 'byor 'dri// 'dir nā ro mkha' spyod skabs kyi tshogs bsags bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi ngag 'don tshigs su bcad par bsdebs pa la/ zur du nyams su len na skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang*/ sgrub thabs dang 'brel ba'i tshe rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas kyi rjes thogs su/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rin chen seng ge'i khri// sna tshogs pad+ma zla ba'i gdan steng du// skyabs gnas kun 'dus drin chen chos kyi rje// rtsa ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas rdo rje chos// sku mdog dmar po rdo rje dril bu bsnol// bgrang bya bcu drug son pa'i lang tsho can// sna tshogs dar dang rin chen rus pas brgyan// zhabs gnyis mi phyed rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs// de mthar brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad ni// dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam pas bskor// gzhan yang yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems// nyan thos rang rgyal chos skyong srung ma dang*// nor lha'i tshogs kyis skor te bzhugs par gyur// kun gyi gnas gsum 'bru gsum yi ges mtshan// hūm̐ las 'od 'phros bla ma yi dam sogs// skyabs yul ma lus spyan drangs dbyer med thim// zhes pas gsal btab nas/ gang gi drin gyis lhan skyes bde ba che// skad cig nyid la 'char ba'i yon tan gter// 'dren mchog bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad+mar spyi bos 'dud// ces dang brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs gang rung 'don/

de ltar mi nus pa'am bsdu na/ smin byed dbang dang byin rlabs rjes su gnang*// ches zab khrid dang rgyab brten lung gi tshogs// dngos dang brgyud pas legs 'doms bla ma'i tshogs// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsol ba btab/ zur du nyams su len na bshams pa'i mchod pa rnams byin rlabs spyi ltar byas la/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi sa twa sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+dapra tīts+tsha swā hā'i bar re re'i 'gor sbyar gyis mchod la/ gang la chags na nyes kun 'byung ba'i gzhi// longs spyod gnyen dang mdza' bshes ji snyed pa// rje btsun bla ma mchog la dbul bar bgyi// 'dod chags rnam rtog zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// mthong thos reg pas zhe sdang 'phel ba'i gzhi// gnod byed dgra 'drer snang ba ji snyed pa// de kun bla ma mchog la dbul bar bgyi// zhe sdang dbyings su zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// tshe rabs du ma grangs med mar byas kyang*// las nyon dbang gis gnyen 'brel ma shes pa// bar ma'i 'gro rnams khyed la dbul bar bgyi// gti mug phrag dog zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// zhes zhen pa spang ngo*// rang sems ngo bo snying ga'i rnal 'byor ma// dbu ma'i lam brgyud tshangs pa'i sgo nas thon// rtsa ba'i bla mar zhal sbyor bzhugs pa yis// phan tshun bde ba chen pos mnyes par gyur// slar yang rang sems mkha' spyod dbang mo yis// rang gi tha mal phung po la gzigs pas// che zhing snum la tsho bar 'dug pa mthong*// sngar yang 'di 'dra'i lus kun don med song*// da lan don can bya'o dgongs nas ni// phung po'i rtsar byon gri gug rnon po yis// tha mal lus su snang ba'i mgo bo yi// ya thod bcad de thod pa'i sgyed pur btsugs// gang de ches dkar yangs pa'i snod gyur par// rkang g.yon g.yas dang khog smad nang khrol dang*// khog stod lag gnyis mgo bo'i lhag mar bcas// de nang bskyur bas sha khrag rus pa'i gter// 'og nas me 'bar thod pa'i nang rdzas rnams// bskol zhing zhu ba kha dog dri ro bcud// phun tshogs bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor oṃ āḥhūm̐/

snying ga'i baṃ las yid 'phrog lha mo'i gzugs// grangs med spros pas thod pa'i bdud rtsi las// bcus nas blangs te 'bul ba'i mchod pa 'di// bdag la brtse ba'i thugs kyis nyer dgongs nas// dgyes pa chen pos bzhes par mdzad du gsol// drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma bka' drin can// 'khor lo'i mgon po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// skyabs gnas kun 'dus zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// dgos 'dod kun 'byung zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// dngos su bshams pa'i nang mchod yod pa'i tshe mtheb srin gyis 'thor// brgyud pa'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// yi dam lha tshogs zhal du= sangs rgyas byang sems zhal du= nyan thos rang rgyal zhal du= chos srung nor lha'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// dgyes par rol nas thugs rgyud zag med kyi// bde ba chen pos yongs su mnyes gyur nas// bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad la// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol// gzhi bdag gnas bdag rigs drug sems can rnams// yi dam lhar gsal zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// chags sdang gti mug rnam rtog zhi ba dang*// byang chub sems 'byangs sangs rgyas thob gyur cig /de nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni/ bdag gzhan lus dang longs spyod dge bar bcas// khor yug lcags ris yongs bskor dbyig 'dzin mar// lha gnas grangs med bkod legs lhun po dang*// gser gyi ri bdun rol pa'i chu gter dang*// dge bcu tshang ba'i gling dang gling phran brgyad// dpag bsam 'dod 'jo'i ba mo ma rmos 'bras// nyi zla lha mi'i dpal 'byor maṇ+ḍal la// 'khor lo'i mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i dpa' bo yis// bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug mda' gzhu legs sbyar nas// sgrib gnyis dgra bo lhag ma med bcom nas// zung 'jug sku bzhi'i rgyal srid thob par mdzod// ces dang*/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun pa dang*/

sa gzhi spos byug dang*/ so bdun can sogs ci nus 'bul bas bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags/ mtha' skor bzhugs pa'i mchod yul thams cad ni// dbyings kyi rol pas rtsa ba'i bla mar thim// sangs rgyas kun 'dus bla ma rin po che// bdag la dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol// bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od dkar po// oṃ gyi gzugs byung rang gi dpral bar thim// bum pa'i dbang thob lus kyi dri ma dag /sku yis byin brlabs sprul sku'i sa bon gzhag /bla ma'i mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od dmar po// āḥyi gzugs byung rang gi mgrin par thim// gsang ba'i dbang thob ngag gi dri ma dag /gsung gis byin brlabs longs sku'i sa bon gzhag /bla ma'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od sngon po// hūm̐ gi gzugs byung rang gi snying gar thim// gsum pa'i dbang thob yid kyi dri ma dag /thugs kyis byin brlabs chos sku'i sa bon gzhag /bla ma'i yi ge gsum las 'od sna tshogs// 'bru gsum gzugs byung rang gi gnas gsum thim// bzhi pa'i dbang thob sgrib pa bag chags dag /kun gyis byin brlabs ngo bo nyid skur gyur// ces pas dbang bzhi blangs/ slar yang 'khor lo'i mgon po mnyes bzhin du// bde ba chen por zhu nas bdag la thim// bdag gi sgo gsum dbyer med 'dres pa'i ngang*// bla ma sku bzhi lhun grub rang zhal skyong*// zhes bla ma rang la bstims nas de kho na nyid kyi ngang du ci gnas su mnyam par gzhag go /de las ldang ba na/ sgrub thabs dang 'brel pa'i tshe/ rang gi snying gar e yig nyis brtsegs sogs la 'jug zur du nyams su len pa'i tshe/ sangs rgyas kun 'du phyi yi bla ma dang*// sems nyid 'od gsal nang gi bla ma dang*// rang bzhin stong gsal don gyi bla ma sogs// dbyer med snying po'i bla mar rtogs par shog /dge ba 'di yis bdag sogs sems can rnams// dngos grub 'byung gnas dpal ldan bla ma la// lhag pa'i lha ru shes pa'i mos gus kyis// dbang dang dngos grub rtag tu len par shog

/skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma sogs// bsngo ba smon lam gang shes brjod do// dpal ldan nā ro ta pa'i thugs kyi bcud// zab lam bsgom pa'i rim pa ngag 'don du// bstar ba'i dge bas don yod rnam pa bzhis// rtag tu dpal ldan bla ma mnyes byed shog /ces nā ro mkha' spyod skabs kyi tshogs bsags bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi ngag 'don nor bu'i phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ ldan yul shod kyi chos ldan sa 'dzin dbang po mgon po rnam rgyal gsung gis bskul ngor ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis sug bris bgyis pa dge bar gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
